description:
The University of Tokyo's scholarship page consolidates funding for international graduate students: the Japanese government's MEXT scholarship, university-run awards, and private-foundation grants. Because each scholarship and graduate school sets its own timeline, applicants should map funding deadlines against their admission round.

Programme Highlights

  • Central hub for MEXT, university and private scholarships
  • MEXT embassy and university recommendations both explained
  • Fee-reduction schemes for self-funded international students
  • Graduate-school-specific timelines to coordinate with admission

Who Should Apply

International applicants to UTokyo master's and doctoral programmes; MEXT routes have nationality and age conditions.

Funding and Costs

Ranges from MEXT full scholarships (tuition plus monthly stipend) to university and private-foundation awards with partial support. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Study the scholarship page, shortlist the awards that match your profile, and synchronise those deadlines with your graduate-school application. Key deadline information: Deadlines vary by scholarship and graduate school — see the official scholarship page.
